Boundary
## Boundary

The human reports Safari crashing on a physical iPhone running iOS 26.7.2.
The successful iOS 27.1 simulator software launch does not qualify that phone.
A fresh actual Daybreak diagnostic proves the existing software warm restore
retains a 634,769,246-byte JavaScript snapshot while the binding creates a full
Wasm copy beside 1 GiB guest RAM (2,343,280,316 bytes before other overhead).
This task removes that expanded JavaScript copy with bounded streaming into
one owned Wasm staging allocation. It preserves the complete core container,
coherence, component and sparse-RAM checks before any machine mutation.

The scope is the shipped fresh software warm path. Keep the current image,
RAM size, guest clocks, core restore semantics, lazy disk and retained factory
GPU runtime unchanged. Do not claim physical-phone compatibility or a proven
OOM cause without a matching log or a physical run. No original cold boot or
long replay is required; those qualifications remain cancelled by the human.


Acceptance contract
## Deterministic acceptance

`make verify-E5.5-T07` runs affected formatting/clippy/native snapshot tests,
the Wasm build, bounded inflater/staging attacks and the actual published
software artifact through the built loader. The 210,695,930-byte compressed
object remains authenticated as 98235fbe8cc4baefefdaab086c700d40c5f5c60d9bf3b26f7642903802214b22.
Streamed output is exactly 634,769,246 bytes with SHA-256
a356cd7455a7b5c7dddb67523e14bcfb07029b8846955ff5245d4a35ac23f762.
There is no full expanded JS ArrayBuffer or second Wasm snapshot allocation
at the new restore boundary. Record maximum copy-chunk size, complete final
state/guest evidence, a bounded real software warm restore and one input echo.
The built demo reaches 127 passed / 0 failed with zero unexpected browser
errors and a screenshot. Test the built software path in iPhone Simulator
through computer use; state its actual OS separately from the physical phone.

A fresh actual Daybreak final critic audits the exact head and evidence,
including one bounded pristine-clone acceptance. Build/commit web/dist, push
an open native stacked PR and deploy/verify main Cloudflare Pages. Never merge.


Verification log — evidence
### 2026-10-28 — worker — start physical-phone memory follow-up

Requested after the human reports the physical browser crashes on iOS 26.7.2.
The phone is an iPhone 16 Pro Max in Device Hub. Xcode crash-report access is
currently refused because Developer Mode is disabled; no security setting
was changed and there is no matching physical crash log. Independent actual
Daybreak diagnostic root 01a184f2-8508-7123-b0fd-feee77c96e59 at clean
f2e4ab0d28b157f6d41e0502d6e690c0baa93cfe confirms the copy/lifetime finding,
not physical crash causation. Audit /private/tmp/wasm-vm-iphone-physical-20261028/daybreak-memory-review-v1/audit.md
SHA-256 6529f7543bcfb9e38ab63b9ec7b3830ba07733d973aa63b0fbe947b739435d56.
The same review independently streamed the actual gzip and proved its complete
length, digest and 16 TLVs. Work continues above open PR625 with no merge.
Adversarial verification
Exercise short/oversize/missing-length streams, empty and excessive staging
sizes, chunk overflow, incomplete buffers, corrupt gzip header/body/trailer,
reader failure and cleanup, foreign core/base/generation, malformed TLV,
invalid sparse run and corrupt final device state. Rejected staging/restore
must leave the machine byte-identical; all fallible preflight remains intact.
Use an independent chunk schedule, a bounded novel attack and one sabotage
check of the new assertions. Authenticate the real compressed and expanded
artifact independently. Carry unchanged prior runtime and simulator HELD
findings forward rather than re-running unrelated gates. Verify no retained
factory GPU identity/artifact was modified or relabelled.
